kept.title: Sidewalk clearing after snow
kept.detail: The City's report says sidewalk clearing begins once snow reaches 2 cm, and a full clearing cycle typically takes about 12 hours. Before clearing finishes, snow may still be on the sidewalks leading to stops.

cites.quote: Under current service levels, the City begins sidewalk clearing once snow accumulation reaches 2 cm.
City crews typically complete a full sidewalk clearing cycle within approximately 12 hours once accumulation reaches 2 cm

kept.title: Laneways are salted only, not plowed
kept.detail: Under the City's service level, public laneways are salted within 24 hours after snowfall ends, and they are not plowed. The report also says snow can end up blocking access in laneways.

cites.quote: The Council-approved winter maintenance service level for public laneways is salting only, within 24 hours after the end of snowfall, to manage icy conditions; snow plowing is not provided.
